payload.title: skill prose restates verb flags
payload.body: The design, plan and note skill cells spell each verb's flags in prose (the '≜ scripts/<cap>.mjs <verb> --flag …' lines), a second hand-kept spelling beside the runtime's declared verb flags, and nothing ties the two. Once undeclared flags are refused with the accepted list, a drifted skill line corrects itself at the first call, so this is a residual, not a gate owed; a canon test comparing each skill's flags with the runtime declaration would close it.
